# Docupilot

Docupilot is a document automation tool that enables users to generate PDFs, DOCX files, contracts, invoices, and more by integrating with various online services.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/docupilot/.

## Actions

- **Create Docupilot Folder**: Create a new folder.
- **Create Docupilot Folder**: Create a new folder.
- **List all folders** (read-only): List all folders.
- **Get Authenticated User** (read-only): Retrieve information about the authenticated user.
